scope: Fixed-source schedule and CONST numerical primitives; no model inference or RNG generation

floatOrder.rounding: FP32 at every listed tensor arithmetic operation. Source configuration uses ordinary float32 default tensor dtype. No expression simplification or fused multiply-add.
floatOrder.table: t=f32(i/1000); t=f32(t*1000); t=f32(t/1000); num=f32(5*t); den=f32(1+f32(4*t)); sigma=f32(num/den), i1..1000. simple6 picks reversed positions and appendszero.
floatOrder.inverse: out=f32(latent/f32(1-sigma)); sigma1 is singular and rejected
floatOrder.flowDenoised: out=f32(input-f32(velocity*sigma)); velocity is the raw model prediction, denoised is x0space
floatOrder.Euler: d=f32(f32(x-denoised)/sigma); dt=f32(nextSigma-sigma); xNext=f32(x+f32(d*dt)); existing Euler kernel owns this primitive

spacesAndHandoff.noiseMixInput: supplied fixed noise and diffusion-normalized clean/handed-off latent; raw VAE latent must be normalized separately before mixing
spacesAndHandoff.inverseOutput: inverse-scaled diffusion-normalized latent, not automatically raw VAE latent
spacesAndHandoff.HIGHend: At sigma3 nonzero, ComfyUI first applies inverse_noise_scaling then Wan21.process_out to expose raw outputslot0. Workflow link22 supplies that output to LOW, not denoised_output.
spacesAndHandoff.LOWstart: ComfyUI normalizes nonzero raw input using Wan21.process_in then applies CONST noise_scaling with zero noise, multiplying latent by1-sigma3. Both conversion orders must be preserved for source parity.
spacesAndHandoff.allZeroSpecialCase: ComfyUI inner_sample skips process_latent_in when raw latent count_nonzero==0. This numeric module does not silently implement that high-level data-dependent conversion.

abi.ownership: Private disjoint caller-owned f32arenas with4bytealignment. Host copies inputs and outputs, clears workspaces, never returns borrowed views.
abi.capacity: pointwise Hike calls1..4096elements, host chunks up to4194304elements; fixed49152bytearena
